verdict.rationale: Appwrite documents broad programmatic coverage. It offers REST and GraphQL APIs plus SDKs, and a CLI that creates and manages projects, rows, files, users and Functions "and other operations available through Appwrite's API." The CLI also runs non-interactively, and an official MCP server lets agents operate on a project. No source explicitly claims that everything doable in the Console is doable via the API. Several features, such as social providers and messaging topics, are described only as Console tabs. missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement of Console/API parity, API-side evidence for Console-described settings (auth provider config, messaging topics), independent corroboration of parity.
